text: On the Gudauri (Post Office)–Kobi section, motor vehicle traffic is prohibited.
On the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section, vehicle traffic is prohibited, the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia reports.
As stated in the Roads Department’s information, the avalanche hazard level on the specified section is high.

“According to the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia, and based on information from the National Environmental Agency, the avalanche danger level is high on the Gudauri (Post)-Kobi section of the Mtskheta-Stepantsminda-Larsi international highway. Therefore, the movement of all types of motor vehicles is temporarily prohibited on this section.”
According to the National Environmental Agency, vehicle traffic on the Mleta-Gudauri section will be carried out in a nonstop passing mode,” the statement says.
